strings.name: A’ja Wilson
strings.summary: A’ja Wilson moved from South Carolina to become the Las Vegas Aces’ offensive and defensive anchor. Her scoring, rebounding and rim protection helped the team win in 2022, 2023 and 2025; she also won two Olympic golds. In 2026 she earned a record fifth regular-season MVP, continuing to shape elite women’s basketball.
